evidence.title: API for Automated Image and Video Generation - Bannerbear

name: Bannerbear
summary: API and no-code platform that auto-generates branded images, videos and PDFs from templates.
description: Template-based media generation over a REST API: render images, multi-image sets, PDFs, animated GIFs, videos and multi-video movies from JSON payloads, chain steps with the Workflow API, and connect 50+ tools like Airtable, Notion, Shopify and Zapier. Also ships free client-side browser tools (background remover, video trim, subtitles, watermark) and an MCP server for AI agents.
contains: image, PDF, animation, video and workflow generation APIs
ready-made template library plus a template editor
50+ integrations incl. Airtable, Notion, WordPress, Zapier; MCP server for AI agents
15+ free client-side browser tools: background remover, video trim/resize, subtitle burn, watermark
5 free online generators: certificate, wedding invite, event ID card, photo collage, invoice
pricing: Automate $49/mo, Scale $149/mo, Enterprise $299/mo; free trial with 30 credits
